title: His brothers, sister and her children
summary: His brothers returned from the war unwell and died; he gives their names and talks about his sister and her children.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: And, what about your brothers and sisters? I mean, what did....?

My sister is still at home. She has a home there now. Like I said, my brothers, they passed on. You know, not too far behind each other because they, after going into the service, when they came back, they weren't quite together. Whatever happened, they were one was in the European, one was in the Pacific.

And, one of my brothers, when he, my youngest brother, when he came back, I brought him to New York with me to stay with me, to stick with me and with my big band. He just went in with me to do and help me out around the band, you know, because, until he kind of got himself together. Then, he went back home.
But, that was Joe, and James, and Edward.

James played trumpet while he was in the service. And my sister now, she's still at home. I was talking to her the other day, with her family. She has two kids now - Frederick and Walweesa. I can't understand just why she gave her that name. But, that's the name she did - Walweesa Erskellina Weaver. That's beautiful after I got used to it.
But, you know, she wanted part of my name with it, which was her first child. So, she called, made the middle name Erskellina.
So, she and I were the only ones left in the main family now besides some cousins.
